title.full: Who you can nominate as CPF nominees

summary.text: You can nominate family members who are not Singaporeans or Permanent Residents as your CPF nominees.

details.heading: Non-Singaporean nominees
details.body: CPF members can nominate any person, including family members who are not Singaporeans or Permanent Residents.

example_phrasings: Can I nominate my family members who are not a Singaporean/ Permanent Resident as my CPF Nominees?
Can I name non-Singaporean family members as CPF nominees?
Can foreigners be my CPF nominees?
Who can I nominate for my CPF?
